subject: Different sequencing depth for Normal and Tumor cell

messages.author: 711eda955b4b3e10
messages.subject: Different sequencing depth for Normal and Tumor cell
parts:
Hi,
The sequencing depth we used for tumor and normal genome are not same, 150x for tumor and 300x for normal.
Could I feed these data to sequenza directly? Will sequenza do something like normalization?
Thanks!

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: Different sequencing depth for Normal and Tumor cell
parts:
Hi,

Yes, there is a pre-processing step in which is performed a GC-content normalization, and it will also take care of the different size in the two libraries.

Best

Francesco
